approved_prompt: Professional studio product photograph of exactly five Maple Moon products: one Pecan Eclipse Bite, one Salted Almond Eclipse Bite, one Hazelnut Eclipse Bite, one Salted Caramel Fudge and one Goji Coconut Bar.
